title: project-autopilot config
description: The v4 `.autopilot/config.json` layout: settings grouped by what you decide, with units in the names.

$schema.description: Path to the JSON schema that gives editor help for this file.

schema_version.description: On-disk config format version; always 4.0 for this layout.

project.description: Project identity and how its work is planned.

repo.description: Intended repository root the mission runs in. Fixed in this version; changing it has no effect. Autopilot uses the folder you run it in, or --repo.

planning_framework.description: How work is planned: standalone, speckit or gsd; auto detects the framework from the repository.

roles.description: The agent CLI, model and session settings for each role.

planner.description: Role settings for the planner, which writes the plan.

cli.description: Agent CLI adapter that runs this role (for example claude, opencode or codex); empty leaves it unset.

model.description: Model id this role uses (for example provider/model); empty means the adapter default.

reasoning.description: Reasoning effort sent to the model (low, medium, high, ...); empty means the adapter default.

variant.description: Extra model variant for adapters that support it; empty means no variant.

resume_session.description: Start from this role's previous session (true) or fresh (false); the implementer defaults to false so a capped run continues fresh with the hand-off note.

fallbacks.description: Fallback CLI and model entries tried in order when the primary one fails; empty means no fallbacks.

cli.description: CLI adapter for this fallback entry.

model.description: Model id for this fallback entry.

reasoning.description: Reasoning effort for this fallback entry; empty uses the role's value.

variant.description: Model variant for this fallback entry; empty uses the role's value.

escalation_model.description: Stronger model used for fix rounds after retries.escalate_after_not_fixed reviews report the same finding not-fixed; null or absent turns escalation off.

cli.description: CLI adapter for the escalation model; required for escalation.

model.description: Model id for the escalation model; required for escalation.

reasoning.description: Reasoning effort for the escalation model; empty uses no explicit effort.

variant.description: Model variant for the escalation model; empty means no variant.

auto_fallback.description: When the effective model is free and the configured fallbacks are used up, try another free model from the same CLI (true) or not (false).

max_turns.description: Most turns a role running a free model may use; 0 turns this extra cap off, and at the limit the run is cut and may continue in a new session.

caps.description: Per-role turn, token and session caps plus the mission token backstop.

task_size_target_turns.description: Implementer turns the planner should aim for per task when splitting work; this is guidance, not a hard limit.

max_turns.description: Most model turns this role may use in one session; at the limit the role stops and hands off, then extra_sessions decides whether a new session may continue.

max_tokens.description: Largest single-turn context (input plus cached input) this role may use; at the limit the role stops and hands off, then extra_sessions decides whether a new session may continue.

extra_sessions.description: Extra sessions this role may start after hitting its turn or token cap; at the limit no further session starts and the mission stops or reports the cap.

wrap_up_at_tokens.description: Token count at which this role is told to wrap up and hand off before max_tokens; at the limit the role writes its hand-off and stops.

mission_token_backstop.description: Cumulative raw tokens (input, cached input and output) allowed across one task; when exceeded the role wraps up and continues in a new backstop session, and two firings in a row stop the task with BACKSTOP_CONSECUTIVE_FIRINGS.

retries.description: How many times each stage may retry or revise before it stops and asks you.

plan_revisions.description: Plan-review escalation point, not a revision count. In standalone, 0 escalates at the first plan-review FAIL without a Planner revision and it runs one fewer revision than the number (the number is one higher than the revisions run), so 1 behaves like 0; SpecKit runs at most one revision per gate for any value above 0; GSD planning still treats 0 or an absent value as 8; an absent value uses the built-in default of 8.

implementation.description: Implementer fix rounds per phase before the phase stops; 0 stops the phase on the first fix-requiring review with no fix round, at the limit the mission stops and asks you, and an absent value uses the built-in default of 4.

verification.description: Verifier FAIL rounds per phase before the phase stops; 0 stops the phase on the first verifier FAIL with no retry, at the limit the mission stops and asks you, and an absent value uses the built-in default of 4.

final_review_fix_rounds.description: Final-review fix rounds per mission before it stops; 1 allows one round, and at the limit the mission stops.

cli_errors.description: Same-model retries after a CLI error before the run gives up; 0 skips same-model retries and fails over or stops on the first CLI error, at the limit the run fails over or stops, and an absent value uses the built-in default of 3.

infrastructure.description: Retries after an infrastructure error such as a snapshot, sandbox or gate failure; 0 stops on the first infrastructure error, at the limit the mission stops, and an absent value uses the built-in default of 3.

no_progress_sessions.description: Sessions in a row that change no file before the task stops; 1 stops on the first session that changes nothing.

extra_sessions_per_task.description: Extra sessions the implementer may start per task after a cap; 0 starts no extra session and an absent value uses the built-in default of 5. The caps.implementer.extra_sessions value wins when both are set.

escalate_after_not_fixed.description: Reviews in a row that must report the same finding not fixed before the stronger escalation model is used; 1 escalates on the first not-fixed report.

time_limits.description: Wall-clock limits and waits, with the unit in each name.

role_timeout_minutes.description: Per-role session time limits in minutes, keyed by role name (for example verifier); past a role's limit that role call is stopped.

default.description: Time limit in minutes for one implementer task; past the limit the implementer call is stopped.

verifier.description: Session time limit for the verifier role, in minutes; past the limit the verifier call is stopped.

call_backstop_minutes.description: Hard wall-clock backstop for one role call, in minutes (not a mission limit); a call that runs past it is stopped. The old name mission_timeout_minutes is still read and migrated.

role_timeout_floor_minutes.description: Lowest session limit that measured run times may produce, in minutes; null or 0 uses the built-in 10-minute floor.

silent_run_minutes.description: Minutes without any output before an active run is treated as hung and stopped; 0 turns this watchdog off.

no_first_output_minutes.description: Minutes a new session may run without producing any output before it is stopped; 0 turns this check off.

read_only_max_silence_minutes.description: Maximum minutes a read-only role may stay silent even while a tool runs before it is stopped; 0 turns this cap off.

retry_wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying after a provider or network error; 0 retries immediately.

workflow.description: Which review and approval stages run, and how work is committed.

plan_review.description: Run the GSD plan-review stage before implementation (true) or skip it (false); only GSD reads this setting. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

plan_review_rounds_converge.description: Make the first plan-review round review the whole plan and later rounds check only the requested fixes (true), or re-review the whole plan every round (false); default true. Applies to standalone and SpecKit planning; GSD uses its own plan-review settings. The legacy name plan_review_convergence is still read and migrated.

gsd_planning_review.description: Use the GSD planning-review stages (true) or skip them (false). (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

spec_review.description: Intended to run a spec review stage before planning. Controlled by your SpecKit workflow.yml — add or remove the step there; this setting has no effect.

code_review_per_phase.description: Run a code review after each implementation phase (true), or skip the per-phase review and rely on the end-of-mission review (false); default true. The legacy name implementationReview is still read and migrated.

final_review.description: Run a final review over the whole mission at the end, including its fix rounds (true), or skip it and complete the mission after implementation (false); default true. The legacy name finalReview is still read and migrated.

analysis_after_tasks.description: Intended to run an analysis pass after all tasks complete. Controlled by your SpecKit workflow.yml — add or remove the step there; this setting has no effect.

approve_spec_myself.description: Intended to approve the spec automatically without asking you. Controlled by your SpecKit workflow.yml — add or remove the step there; this setting has no effect.

pause_for_plan_approval.description: Approve the plan automatically without asking you (true) or pause after planning and wait for you to approve it (false); default false. Applies to standalone and SpecKit planning. When paused, a following `ap run` continues as the approval.

parallel_independent_tasks.description: Intended to run independent tasks in parallel. Not used by this version; changing it has no effect.

use_worktrees.description: Intended to run parallel tasks in separate git worktrees. Not used by this version; changing it has no effect.

commit_by_human.description: Stop at "ready to commit" and let you commit; false is not supported because Autopilot never commits.

tests.description: Gate commands, reviewer requirement and verification policy.

gate_commands.description: Commands run after each phase and at the end as the gate; a failing command fails the phase, and an empty list runs no gate.

gate_network.description: Allow the gate commands to use the network (true); false keeps them network-isolated.

gate_env_allowlist.description: Environment variable names allowed through to gate commands; empty passes no extra variables.

require_reviewer.description: Intended to require a reviewer verdict before a phase passes. Fixed in this version; changing it has no effect.

browser.description: Browser capability used for verification: native (the agent's own browser), playwright or both.

require_browser.description: How browser capabilities are required for the verifier: always adds them to every call; when-task-requires and never add them only when the task itself needs a browser.

verify_denylist.description: Commands or paths that a task or verification step may never run; empty adds no bans beyond the built-in full-suite ban.

e2e.description: End-to-end test tool for UI projects: playwright, cypress or none. Unset (null) = setup asks once; treated as none until answered.

e2e_setup_pending.description: True while an end-to-end tool setup is still pending for the project; unset or false means nothing is pending.

safety.description: What roles may do and which safety checks are enforced.

allow_git_commit.description: Setting this true is rejected; Autopilot never commits, so keep it false.

allow_git_push.description: Setting this true is rejected; Autopilot never pushes, so keep it false.

allow_destructive_operations.description: Setting this true is rejected; destructive operations stay blocked, so keep it false.

stop_on_sandbox_violation.description: Setting this false is rejected; a sandbox or relay violation always stops the mission, so keep it true.

block_git_in_roles.description: Blocks git commit and push inside role sessions. Always on — cannot be turned off; changing it has no effect.

check_read_only_roles.description: Checks that read-only roles changed no file by comparing before and after snapshots. Always on — cannot be turned off; changing it has no effect.

record_touched_files.description: Records the files each role touches. Always on — cannot be turned off; changing it has no effect.

keep_role_sessions.description: Keeps role sessions on disk so a later run can resume them. Always on — cannot be turned off; changing it has no effect.

runtime.description: Containment mode and, for WSL2, the distribution to use.

mode.description: How roles are contained: auto, linux-strong, wsl2-strong or windows-compatibility.

wsl_distro.description: WSL2 distribution used for wsl2-strong mode; null detects it automatically.

frameworks.description: Per-framework planning settings for SpecKit and GSD.

workflow_file.description: Intended path to the SpecKit workflow definition. Fixed in this version; changing it has no effect. Autopilot always reads .specify/workflows/speckit/workflow.yml.

task_files.description: Glob patterns that identify SpecKit task files; empty means no task files are found.

gsd.description: GSD phase, artifact and parallelism settings. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

phase_root.description: Directory holding GSD phase folders. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

run_plan_verify.description: Run the gsd-tools plan check (references and state validation) after planning (true) or skip it (false). (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

run_state_validate.description: Intended to run GSD state validation. Not used by this version; changing it has no effect. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

write_summary_artifacts.description: Intended to write GSD summary artifacts. Not used by this version; changing it has no effect. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

write_verification_artifacts.description: Intended to write GSD verification artifacts. Not used by this version; changing it has no effect. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

write_uat_artifact.description: Intended to write the GSD UAT artifact. Not used by this version; changing it has no effect. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

use_gsd_tools_when_available.description: Use GSD helper tools when they are available (true) or skip them (false). (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

planning_review.description: GSD planning-review stage settings. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

enabled.description: Enable the GSD planning-review stages (true) or skip them (false). (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

review_after_each_stage.description: Intended to review after every GSD planning stage. Not used by this version; changing it has no effect. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

stages.description: GSD planning stages to review: discuss, research and plan. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

max_revisions.description: Revisions allowed per GSD planning stage; at the limit the stage fails and the mission stops. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

read_only_reviewer.description: Intended to use a read-only reviewer for GSD planning review. Not used by this version; changing it has no effect. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

parallel.description: Parallel GSD execution settings. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

enabled.description: Allow GSD work to run in parallel (true) or one at a time (false). (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

plan_level.description: Allow different GSD plans to run in parallel (true) or one plan at a time (false). (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

task_level.description: Tasks inside one GSD plan always run one at a time; this setting has no effect. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

max_concurrent_agents.description: Most GSD agents that may run at once; at the limit new work waits for a free slot. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

min_plans_for_parallel.description: Smallest number of plans that starts GSD parallel execution; below it plans run one at a time. (GSD is not yet reviewed in this version).

advanced.description: Paths, hand-off limits and capability defaults.

state_file.description: Intended path to the mission state file. Fixed in this version; changing it has no effect.

runs_dir.description: Intended directory holding run records. Fixed in this version; changing it has no effect.

handoff_max_chars.description: Maximum characters in a role hand-off document; longer text is cut, and values below 500 are rejected.

handoff_note_max_chars.description: Maximum characters in a hand-off note; longer text is cut, and values below 1000 are rejected.

handoff_wrapup_tokens.description: Token count at which a role is told to wrap up its hand-off; it must be below the implementer token cap.

fallback_retry_primary_minutes.description: Minutes to wait before retrying the primary model after a fallback took over; 0 uses the built-in 60-minute wait.

checkpoint_after_task.description: Intended to write a checkpoint after each task. Fixed in this version; changing it has no effect.

checkpoint_after_phase.description: Intended to write a checkpoint after each phase. Fixed in this version; changing it has no effect.

project_defaults.description: Capabilities assumed present for every role in this project; empty adds none.

role_requirements.description: Extra capabilities required per role, keyed by role name; empty adds none.

safety_denied.description: Intended to deny capabilities for safety. Fixed in this version; changing it has no effect.

legacy_text_inference.description: Infer browser capabilities from task text for the verifier (legacy); false keeps inference off.
